scenario: A visa-profile closure should begin from the support lane and only close after packet, traveler profile, override, and live requirement checks still point to the cancellation lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the visa-profile review for my Tokyo booking. Start from support ticket TCK-1226 and the visa packet it points to, then use the profile and override records it references before taking the approved close step.

travel_support_tickets.body_text: Visa-profile ticket TCK-1226: review visa packet VPK-1226 for booking BK-1226. Then check traveler profile TPN-1226 and override note OVR-1226. If the live Tokyo entry rule still requires a visa for this traveler profile and no override waiver exists, the approved close step is cancellation.

travel_visa_packet_texts.body_text: Visa packet VPK-1226 confirms booking BK-1226 on JL67 from LAX to HND. Traveler profile reference: TPN-1226. Override reference: OVR-1226. No completed visa issuance document is attached.

travel_traveler_profile_notes.body_text: Traveler profile TPN-1226: nationality CN, passport valid, no multi-entry Japan visa on file.

travel_trip_override_notes.body_text: Trip override OVR-1226: no manual consular waiver, embassy expedite, or entry exception has been approved for BK-1226.
